k_registry.PROHIBITION: k_hub = 4 belongs ONLY to this new forward family. It is NOT a retroactive effective k for the 20,751 historical tests and NOT a compression of the 732. No historical p-value may be recomputed against it.

H1_VOL_BUCKET.definition: promoted claims containing ANY frozen vol_bucket token, either side

H2_GAP_V.definition: promoted claims containing bar_gap_range==V, either side

H3_VOL_CONSTRUCT.definition: promoted claims containing sig_va==TRUE or sig_vol_5x==TRUE, either side

H4_LSIG_M1_STAR.definition: M1->M2 promoted claims whose token_A is l_sig==L3 or l_sig==L46

COUNT_RECONCILIATION.H2: the census reported 175 TOKEN OCCURRENCES of bar_gap_range==V; the hub has 173 CLAIMS because 2 claims carry it on both sides. Membership is by CLAIM.
COUNT_RECONCILIATION.H4: l_sig==L3/L46 appear on the A side of 57 promoted claims overall; 48 of those are M1->M2, which is the registered definition.

OVERLAP.policy: NO disjoint partition is attempted. The shared forward permutation preserves this overlap and the resulting dependence.

HUB_STATISTIC.theta_j: median(Y | positive_j) - median(Y | evaluable nonpositive_j), unchanged from the historical design
HUB_STATISTIC.THETA_h: median over j in hub h of theta_j

studentisation.c_h: median over SCALE draws of THETA_h^(b)

HUB_STATISTIC.max_stat: M_hub^(b) = max over the 4 hubs of T_h^(b)
HUB_STATISTIC.rationale: all theta_j share one ATR-normalised unit; the median prevents one or two extreme members from steering a hub

CONFIRMATION_RULE.PERMITTED_ON_PASS: at least one post-DEV registered structural motif replicated in clean forward data — naming exactly which hub(s)
FORBIDDEN: 'all four hubs confirmed' when fewer passed
attributing a hub pass to the whole 732 set
any member claim inheriting confirmation from its hub

SECONDARY_FAMILY.question: which specific historical claim replicates forward
SECONDARY_FAMILY.HARD_SEPARATION: HUB CONFIRMED != every member claim confirmed. INDIVIDUAL CLAIM CONFIRMED requires its own 732-family forward test.

FORWARD_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.starts: the first eligible session strictly AFTER the forward prespec seal
FORWARD_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.backfill: FORBIDDEN — no later-arriving data for 2026-08-25..31 or any pre-seal date may enter confirmation

NOT_YET_FROZEN: B_NULL / B_SCALE for the forward run
